lede: Tampa Bay had last change, so Jon Cooper picked most of these matchups. Tampa Bay played without Zemgus Girgensons and Brandon Hagel. Edmonton played without Ryan Nugent-Hopkins.

notes.head: Cirelli’s line drew McDavid’s line
notes.text: Jon Cooper sent Mikheyev, Cirelli and Holmberg out for 10:18 of their 13:05 at 5-on-5 against Dach, McDavid and Hyman (79%, about 28% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.75 to 0.15 expected goals. Tampa Bay scored one of its three goals then.

notes.head: Kucherov’s line drew Draisaitl’s line
notes.text: Guentzel, Point and Kucherov spent 11:18 of their 15:35 at 5-on-5 against Podkolzin, Draisaitl and Kapanen (73%, about 30% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.32 to 0.46 expected goals.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Dickinson’s line
notes.text: Viel, Harkins and Sabourin spent 6:33 of their 9:53 at 5-on-5 against Hållander, Dickinson and Frederic (66%, about 24% with no line matching).

notes.head: One matchup paid off
notes.text: Gourde, O'Reilly and Goncalves kept drawing Edmonton’s fourth line, Formenton, Michaels and Joseph. In those 5:04 Tampa Bay had 0.72 expected goals to Edmonton’s 0.09.

foot: Jon Cooper matched about as hard as in his other home games: each line spent 69% of its time against one opposing line, against 44% to 76% in his first nine.
